**The problem**

What are you trying to do, and what stops you today? Describe the use case before the solution.

**The proposal**

What you would like Rebound to do. Sketch the API if you have one in mind.

```go

```

**Does it change the contract?**

- [ ] Public Go API
- [ ] Wire protocol (HTTP statuses, SSE frames, error codes)
- [ ] Store interface or guarantees
- [ ] New dependency
- [ ] None of these

Any box above means the change needs an ADR (see CONTRIBUTING.md); we can write it together here.

**Alternatives you considered**

Other designs, workarounds, or existing libraries.

**Would you like to work on it?**

Yes / no / with some help.
